result.summary: 041 is not a contradiction: recorder monotonicity covered a bounded active prefix, while FAST-LIO callback-local loop-back came from later full-window callback delivery after the active recorder had stopped.
result.primary_cause_supported_by_static_eviden: source publishers stamp Livox and IMU with node now(); 041 full source logs show post-prefix runtime timestamp backward ordering; FAST-LIO compares delivered header stamps against persistent last_timestamp_lidar/last_timestamp_imu state.
result.dds_queue_stale_delivery_role: possible contributor because FAST-LIO and the recorder are independent subscribers with different queue depths and lifetimes, but static evidence points first to full-window node-clock/replay-boundary behavior.

claim_boundary: FAST-LIO callback/DDS/replay-boundary diagnosis only; no FAST-LIO success, TF/RViz readiness, localization quality, local-map quality, planner_ready, controller performance, mission success, or closed_loop claim.
